title: Welcome to the Nightcap Wiki
summary: Your field guide to a different kind of Classic adventure.
body:
In development — not released: High Keep prison break adds an entrance confrontation, zone-wide warnings and an Osargen escort. Existing live High Keep runs still use their current rules.

The Hole entrance

Live testing — keyless Hole entrance: The Hole Key and lock-picking requirement have been removed from the entrance rock in Paineel at /loc 568,-896,-96. Click the rock to open the passage without a key or lock picks. The server update is installed; in-game acceptance is pending. Paineel city-lift keys and the Sacred Key doors inside The Hole remain unchanged.

Find your next upgrade

Choose up to three held classes and find current-era equipment, its source mobs, locations and calculated drop chances. Open the loot finder. Production content refreshes automatically every fifteen minutes.

Live testing — Hate Keeper in Commonlands: Find the Plane of Hate Keeper in East Commonlands at /loc -1570,-346,3, between Mirielle and Khalure in the travel area. Raid, Grind and return entry lead to Hate; private Hate instances retain an entrance Keeper. Public and private Hate entry require level 46; GM status is no longer required. The server update is installed. The owner confirmed the relocation, Commonlands visibility and Hate travel. Broader dungeon balance and full-clear QA remain separate.

Live testing: The Classic raid rewards give every dungeon three exclusive designs. The 14 added dungeons contribute 42 designs in two qualities; all 414 dungeon rewards are MAGIC. Fear, Hate and Sky receive lore-driven relics and equipped utility clicks. Gameplay and balance acceptance remain pending.

Live testing: Every Classic dungeon coverage adds the same Raid/Grind choices in 21 combat dungeon zones, including Fear, Hate and Sky. All 21 are installed for live testing; gameplay and balance acceptance remain pending.

Live testing: quest ingredient qualities

Quest hand-ins and deliveries now accept Polished, Exalted and Ascended versions of Normal ingredients. Try the Crafted Gauntlets turn-in and review the limits.

Live testing: Crafted and four other reviewed class-armor families now award Ascended gear. Original quest requirements remain.

Live testing: The Classic robe waist correction is available for seven races in game 2026102204. Close the game and update through the launcher; native visual acceptance remains open.

Level-scaled AA — live testing: Earn two AA per level while leveling. From level 1, use the AA +/− buttons to choose 0–100%; 100% pauses leveling so you can grind AA where you prefer. Close EverQuest and update through launcher Play for game 2026102301. Existing points, purchases and partial progress stay intact. AA progression and examples.

THJ behavior and stock gear — live testing

The custom AA, spell focus and stock-derived gear update is installed for live testing. Scaling uses 131 researched Legendary items and matching standard EverQuest baselines. Classic level 50 and starter progression are preserved. Reopen the normal launcher for game 2026101902 before testing. See behavior details and open testing limits.

Live AA testing: All 16 classes have more earned AA options: 75 newly available lines, 111 expanded lines and Druid access to Healing Boon. The latest custom behavior update retires Spell Casting Subtlety and obsolete Silent Casting modifiers, with recorded-cost refunds. Classic remains level 50. Reconnect and turn Recommended AA off to browse your held classes. Read the AA update.

Launch repair published: Game update 2026101901 corrects the client catalog mismatch that blocked Play after the previous update. Close EverQuest and the launcher, reopen your normal Nightcap shortcut, and press Play to receive the repair. Your game settings and the other managed files are preserved. Native login and gameplay confirmation remain open.

Live testing: The item/spell and pet/melee release is available for live testing. Reopen the launcher for the matching client update, then check your gear, spells and pet equipment. Classic level 50 remains active.

Ordinary loot quality chances are now 20% Polished, 5% Exalted and 1% Ascended per eligible item drop. Loot quality details.

October 18 update: Independent AA cooldowns and item/discipline timer repairs are available for live testing. Reconnect before testing; existing waits retain their original expiry.

October 18: Classic travel archive repair is available through normal launcher Play, including West Commonlands. Close EverQuest before updating.

October 17 update: Recommended AA, passive AA while leveling, no normal-death EXP loss, stacks of at least 100, three-Normal reforging and independent Monk attacks are available for live testing. Close EQ and use launcher Play.

  • Zones & rewards48 Classic destinations and their rewards.

  • Travel & instancesFind your way out. Find your way home.

Adventures & quests

  • Advanced lootPersonal drops, filters and group rolls.
  • Ascension questReforge your original class epic.
  • Waypoint ExplorerDiscover destinations and earn a title.

New in Nightcap

Raid or Grind in all 21 Classic dungeons. Complete personal boss checklists for new rewards, with exclusive Raid drops. Available for live testing.

Build, craft and upgrade. Early spell scribing, stacked tradeskills and Craft All, reusable item upgrades, and equipment for your held classes are live. The normal-item box recipe is available for live testing.

Passive AA is now 10% alongside normal leveling. Read the latest changes →

At the campfire

  • Keep the command reference handy
  • Update your launcher and game
  • Read about combat and recovery
  • See what is still in development

Nightcap is in live testing. Feature labels distinguish installed systems from unreleased work.

The Vigil of the Dawn — live testing

Camil’s Vigil of the Dawn is available for live testing. Begin in East Commonlands with a level-50 character holding Paladin, then visit the Keeper near Befallen in West Commonlands. Read the quest guide and reward catalog.
